threshold_rule.label: below 5 ms: not gated (user 2026-10-24)
threshold_rule.applies: a process whose pyAmpliCol time per point at B = 128 is below 5 ms has no blocking gate: its ratio and band stay as measured and are shown, its verdict is the label; the batched time is the configuration's own at B = 128 (the gate batch, user 2026-10-28: every other batch size, B = 1 and the 2->5 rows' B = 16 included, is reported with its ratio and band and carries no verdict; a configuration without a B = 128 timing, e.g. the one-lane runs, has none, never one derived from another batch size); it takes precedence over a decision; the exact-rational vs binary64 input question is therefore moot and the protocol stays
threshold_rule.source: workspace/reports/engine-v2/slice-status.md, DECISIONS, 2026-10-24 ~22:35 UTC (USER: summary pages and gate focus, GATE RULE; binding for the milestone push's report:gint and for gate verdicts)

gate_classes.reported: four legs or fewer (2->1, 1->2, 2->2, 1->3): reported, no gate (PLAN §5.2)
gate_classes.gated: 2->3 upward with a matched provider: B = 128 median on TIRust faster than MadLoop and <= 1.30x each matched OpenLoops and Recola time; below 5 ms not gated (PLAN §5.2, Q35, Q40)
gate_classes.gated where a provider matches: as gated, where a matched provider timing exists or is obtainable within 45 min; else reported with the reason
gate_classes.optional: 2->4 optional: gated where run and matched (PLAN §4.1 LI-44)
gate_classes.stretch: 2->5 stretch: internal; gated only if a provider matches (PLAN §4.1 LI-51)
gate_classes.eft: TIR only (rank > N+2, lit-eft): its gate follows its multiplicity once the process is fixed

meta.rule: every row of the registry (milestone.json loop_induced, PLAN §4.1 process rows) by multiplicity; the cell is the newest record's batched B = 128 time per point (git ancestry of the record revisions) of the backend 'auto' serves at that revision (its effective backend labelled; records without a request: the default backend TIRust first, NinjaRS per amplitude labelled where only NinjaRS is timed), never a record with failed points; the other backend beside it with its served fraction and the recorded cause of its failed points, its time only where it served every point; the ratio to the fastest matched provider (production mode) colours it; generation = the full production generate cost (generate + the exact helicity-zero filter + plan export + the mandatory generation-time probes, their share shown), uncoloured; every record names its host; four legs or fewer reported, below the 5 ms rule not gated, gate verdicts only from lit-perf's records; a row whose serving package has not landed, or whose input file does not exist yet, is pending; nothing estimated or extrapolated
